query: For my 69-year-old female with AKI: among female patients 64–74 with AKI, median (IQR) diagnostic imaging studies per admission for 1–3 vs 4–7 days, stratified by primary vs secondary diagnosis?
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.age, d.long_title AS primary_diagnosis, d2.long_title AS secondary_diagnosis, s.stay_id, COUNT(m.microevent_id) AS num_imaging_studies, (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY COUNT(m.microevent_id)) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY COUNT(m.microevent_id))) AS interquartile_range FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id JOIN d_icd_diagnoses d2 ON d.icd_code = d2.icd_code JOIN microbiologyevents m ON a.subject_id = m.subject_id JOIN icustays s ON a.subject_id = s.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.age BETWEEN 64 AND 74 AND d.icd_code = '404.0' AND m.test_name = 'Imaging' AND s.stay_length BETWEEN 1 AND 7 GROUP BY p.gender, p.age, d.long_title, d2.long_title, s.stay_id ORDER BY p.gender, p.age, d.long_title, d2.long_title, s.stay_id NULLS LAST;
